Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.runtime

Interface HandlerContext

All Known Implementing Classes:
EventHandlerContext, LocalHandlerContext
public interface HandlerContext
Provides runtime information about the current function invocation.

This context is passed to every CloudRequestHandler and includes platform-specific metadata such as request ID, function name, and resource limits. Implementations of this interface are provided by the platform adapter (e.g., AWS Lambda or Azure Functions).

      default EventMetadata getEventMetadata()
      Returns the metadata of the event that invoked the function.

      Functions usually declare a parameter of type EventMetadata instead of calling this method.

      Returns:
      the event metadata, or null if the invocation was not an event (for example an HTTP request or a schedule)
